name: Amenities
note: Contractor-installed price (incl. general conditions and OH&P) for each amenity. Excludes FF&E/loose equipment unless noted, soft costs and land. Public municipal bids are the main evidence; developer-built amenities at multifamily/RV/hospitality projects are usually smaller and somewhat cheaper than municipal versions, which is why several mids sit below the municipal awards.

items.name: Resort-style community pool with deck (≈1,500–2,500 SF of water)

cost.method: Built up from pool-per-sf: 2,000 SF water × $320/SF (pool-per-sf mid) = $640k, plus ≈4,000–6,000 SF of concrete/paver deck, pool fence, lighting and a small equipment room, which brings a plain pool to the low end (1,500 SF × ~$200/SF + deck ≈ $350k) and a 2,500 SF resort pool with sun shelf, spa and premium deck to the high end (2,500 SF × ~$400 + extras ≈ $1.1M). Cross-check: Van Wert OH community pool (e6) at $7.5M for 9,384 SF water + 32,806 SF deck/grass ≈ $800 per SF of water all-in for a municipal facility with bathhouse-type support, so a 2,000 SF amenity pool at $325/SF of water all-in is plausible for private multifamily scope. Evidence years: Chico 2015, Rec Management 2024, Van Wert 2024 prices.

items.notes: Includes pool shell, finish, filtration/heater/chemical equipment, coping, deck, code fence and pool lighting. Excludes cabana/clubhouse building (use clubhouse), shade structures (pavilion-shade), pool furniture (FF&E). Spa adds roughly $60k–$150k (judgment).

items.name: Swimming pool, per SF of water surface (shell, finish, mechanical)

cost.method: Chico CA aquatics feasibility (2015 $) gives pool-only construction of $145/SF (teaching pool, e3), $185/SF (25-yd lap pool, e2) and $270/SF (multipurpose recreation pool, e4). Rec Management (e1) puts the 2024 average at ≈$488/SF (scope undefined; treated as the high end, likely includes deck/mechanical building). Chico values are 9 years old; construction costs rose roughly 50% 2015→2024, so Chico ≈ $215–$400/SF in 2024 terms — low $200 and mid $320 sit in that band; high = e1 rounded.

items.notes: Per SF of water surface. Pool shell, plaster/tile finish, coping, filtration, pumps, heaters, chemical feed, pool lighting. Deck, fencing and support buildings are extra. Leisure/zero-entry pools run toward the high end, simple rectangular lap pools toward the low end.

items.name: Clubhouse / amenity building

cost.method: RSMeans public model pages (2019 data, US national average). Construction cost = SubTotal + contractor fees (GC/OH&P), excluding the 8% architectural fee included in RSMeans 'Total'. Low = Social Club open shop ($113.60 × 1.25 = $142); mid = Country Club open shop ($148.69 × 1.25 = $186); high = Country Club union ($205.36) × 1.4 for luxury multifamily clubhouse finishes (judgment). Kept in 2019 dollars for the build-script escalation.

items.notes: Stand-alone amenity building (leasing, lounge, kitchenette, restrooms) — building only, no sitework or FF&E. Use fitness-room for the gym portion if built as separate space.

items.name: Fitness room / gym space (built space, excl. equipment)

cost.method: RSMeans Gymnasium model (e21, 2019 data): construction = SubTotal + contractor fees = $129.64 × 1.25 = $162 open shop; $141.48 + $35.37 = $177 union. Mid $175 ≈ union; low $150 for space carved inside a larger building; high = ×1.5 for boutique finishes (rubber floors, mirrors, AV, extra HVAC) — judgment.

items.notes: Excludes fitness equipment (typically $40–$80 per SF of fitness room for commercial-grade cardio/strength packages — judgment; carry in FF&E).

items.name: Playground (commercial-grade structure, safety surfacing, borders)

cost.method: No clean per-playground bid tab captured. Santa Monica's inclusive Douglas Park playground (e17, NTE $1.9M incl. 10% contingency, 2023) is a destination municipal playground and is treated as an outlier above the range. Range is judgment for multifamily/RV/park-sized playgrounds: low = single modular structure with engineered wood fiber; mid = 2–12-year-old structures with poured-in-place rubber; high = larger inclusive playground with shade. Verify with local bids.

items.notes: Includes equipment, installation, safety surfacing, edging and drainage. Shade sails extra (pavilion-shade).

items.name: Sport court (tennis or basketball), post-tension concrete, fenced

cost.method: College Station TX (e12, Oct 2024): $1,041,469 for 6 tennis courts on post-tension slabs incl. demolition, waterline relocation, regrade, fencing, nets = $173.6k/court; lighting by separate Musco contract $332,655 = $55.4k/court. Mid $150k = tennis court without demolition/utility relocation; high $230k = e12 + lighting; low $75k = half-court/full basketball court on asphalt or concrete (judgment: roughly half the area of a tennis court, no 10-ft fence).

items.notes: Tennis court ≈ 7,200 SF (60×120). Basketball court ≈ 4,700 SF full court. Lighting typically adds $40k–$60k per court (e12).

items.name: Outdoor pickleball court (post-tension concrete, fenced)

cost.method: Three 2025 municipal awards: Troy MI (e9) $489,510 / 8 courts = $61.2k/court (PT concrete, windscreen, 2 sun shades, no lighting); Farragut TN (e10) $856,742 / 9 courts = $95.2k/court (incl. LED lighting, fencing, shaded seating); Tuscaloosa AL (e11) $1,373,029 / 8 courts = $171.6k/court (incl. new parking lot). Mid $85k between e9 and e10 (bank of courts with lighting); low = e9 rounded down for larger banks; high = e11.

items.notes: Assumes courts built in banks of 4+; a single stand-alone court costs more per court. Troy bid tab: post-tension 5-inch concrete court slab $113.15/SY (≈$12.57/SF).

items.name: Dog park (fenced, double-gated, surfacing, waste stations, water)

cost.method: Wichita Falls TX (e15, 2025): $64,500 for a park with small/large dog areas and 1,400 LF of 6-ft chain link. Farragut TN (e16): $562,000 low bid for a municipal dog park with vinyl fencing, ADA aggregate paths, retaining walls and landscaping. Private amenity dog parks (multifamily, RV) are typically 3,000–15,000 SF; low $30k = small turf/gravel run with 4-ft fence (judgment); mid $90k ≈ e15 scaled up for synthetic turf and water; high ≈ e16 (municipal-scale).

items.notes: Synthetic pet turf on drainage base ($12–$20/SF, judgment) is the main driver for small amenity dog parks.

items.name: Pavilion / shade structure (open-sided roofed)

cost.method: Judgment. Fixr (e23, residential, 2022) gives roofed pergola/pavilion structures at $5,700–$30,000 and open pergolas at $10–$40/SF installed. Commercial prefabricated steel pavilions with footings and slab typically run higher than residential pergolas: low $40/SF (shade sail or simple steel frame on existing slab), mid $75/SF (prefab steel pavilion with roof, footings and slab), high $150/SF (custom timber/masonry pavilion with lighting and power).

items.notes: Per SF of roof footprint. Include slab if none exists. Troy MI pickleball bid (e9) carried two court sun shades at $22,500 each.

items.name: Splash pad (spray ground)

cost.method: Webster City IA engineer's estimate $448,550 (e8, 2023); Sugar Land TX contract $579,451 (e7, Jan 2026); Chico CA feasibility $250,000 (e5, 2015 $). Mid = e8 rounded (≈ median); low = small flow-through pad near e5; high = recirculating pad with treatment, larger than e7 (judgment).

items.notes: Flow-through (potable to sewer) pads are cheaper to build but costly to run; recirculating pads add a treatment vault/pump room (≈$100k–$200k, judgment).

items.name: Restroom building (prefab or site-built, park/amenity)

cost.method: Neither award states square footage. Fresno CA (e13, bids Dec 2025): $608,363 for a prefabricated 4-stall ADA restroom incl. new sewer/water service and accessible path. Savannah GA (e14, Dec 2024): $264,927 to design, manufacture and install a prefab CMU restroom. Assuming ≈350 SF for e14 and ≈450–500 SF for e13 (typical 2–4-stall park restroom footprints, judgment), the awards imply ≈$750/SF (e14) and ≈$1,200–$1,350/SF incl. utility work (e13). Low $450 = site-built restroom inside a larger amenity site with utilities at the pad.

items.notes: Small buildings carry high $/SF because plumbing fixtures, vandal-resistant finishes and utility connections dominate. Utility service extensions beyond 50 ft are extra.

items.name: Bathhouse with showers and laundry (RV park / campground)

cost.method: Derived. RSMeans Laundromat model (e22b, 2019 data) = $216–$235/SF construction (open shop $172.84 × 1.25; union $187.98 + $47.00), a plumbing-heavy small building comparable to a bathhouse; that is ≈$300–$330/SF in 2025 terms (≈+40% 2019→2025), used as the low. Mid $450 sits between that and the restroom-building low-to-mid ($450–$750/SF) because bathhouses (1,000–3,000 SF) spread fixed costs over more area than a single restroom. High $700 = small bathhouse with premium finishes.

items.notes: Typical RV park ratio ≈ 1 toilet + 1 shower per sex per 15–25 sites (state codes vary); laundry adds 150–300 SF. Excludes washers/dryers (often vendor-leased).

items.name: Mail kiosk (USPS cluster box units under a roofed kiosk)

cost.method: No source captured (web search limit reached). Judgment: USPS-approved cluster box units at ≈$1,500–$3,000 per 16-door unit installed on a pad (low = 4–6 CBUs on a slab with no roof); mid = 200–300-unit community with 15–20 CBUs/parcel lockers in a 300–500 SF roofed kiosk; high = enclosed, conditioned mail room or large kiosk with electronic parcel lockers. Verify with a CBU supplier quote.

items.notes: Size from unit count: roughly 1 CBU door per dwelling unit plus parcel lockers at ≈1 per 10 units (USPS guidance — verify locally with the postmaster).

items.name: Outdoor kitchen / grill station

cost.method: Fixr (e22, Feb 2025): $6,000–$30,000 typical, $16,000 national average, $65,000 high-end custom. Commercial amenity grill stations use commercial-grade built-in grills and accessible counters, so the mid is set ≈25% above e22's average ($20k); high = e22 high.

items.notes: Per station (built-in grill, counter, sink optional). Power/gas/water run from building ≤ 50 ft. Shade structure extra.
